searxng.description: Web search via SearXNG (meta search - Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, etc.)
searxng._note: Auto-installed at runtime via npm into /app/mcp/node_modules (persisted in the mcp-packages volume) and run as a native subprocess - nothing baked into the image, no docker, no socket. Reaches SearXNG over the compose network (SEARXNG_URL=http://searxng:8080).

mcp-discord.description: Send and fetch messages from Discord channels

whatsapp.description: Send WhatsApp messages via the PAAW WhatsApp bot (Baileys). Talks to the bot's HTTP bridge - it does NOT open its own WhatsApp session.
whatsapp._note: Local MCP shipped with PAAW (mcp/whatsapp-baileys/index.js), run as a native subprocess. Its only dependency (the MCP SDK) is auto-installed at runtime into /app/mcp/node_modules, which index.js resolves via Node's parent-directory module lookup. Forwards to the always-on 'whatsapp' bridge at whatsapp:3000.

_comment: MCP servers are auto-installed at runtime - add a 'package' field (npm package name) and they install on first use into /app/mcp/node_modules. No image rebuild needed. Use ${VAR} for environment variables and set 'enabled: true' to activate.
